event.description:
ENTRY:
- $50

START TIME:
- 12:00 pm

FORMAT:
- Constructed

STRUCTURE:
- 60 Min (+5 min) Swiss Rounds
- Best of 3
- No Top Cut
- Decklists required


PRIZES:
~~BOOSTERS
[Participation]
- 2 Booster Packs
*Booster Packs to Scale with Attendance

~~PROMOS
[Winner]
- 1 Nationals Invite
- 1 Regional Champion Playmat
[Top 4/8]
- 1 Nationals invite
- 1 Regionals Finalist Playmat
[Participation]
- 1 Regional Binder
- 1 Regional Exclusive Booster Pack
- 1 Event Pack
- 1 Sapphire Pack

*Each player will get one Event Pack upon entry to the event, all other event packs should be split among the top players.
*All remaining Sapphire Packs should be distributed to the top players, with a higher quantity going to the players with a higher placing.



**All promotional items subject to availability.**
